user.title: Tapo camera
user.description: Log in like Tapo Control: either the camera account (Tapo app → camera → Settings → Advanced settings → Camera account), or leave it empty and enter the TP-Link cloud password (the camera is then logged in to as "admin").

data_description.cloud_password: When set, it is used instead of the camera account, like Tapo Control.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the alarm and notification settings are read.
